newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Feb 20.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5649. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- South Korean state prosecutors indicted owner of Hanbo Group Chung Tai-soo and 9 people for diverting 213.6 billion won
- South Korean state procecutors indict 10 in Hanbo scandal
- South Korean government to send $6 million in food aid to North Korea through the World Food Programme.
- 87 percent of 500 people polled have answered Hanbo case must be reinvestigated with a special prosecusion system.
